hypotheses.settle_wait: rejected. Cursor was already visible after 1.0s. hello still absent. MAD 0.022.
hypotheses.click_engages_text_mode: rejected as a fix. UIKit cursor and AutoFill appeared after an in-field click. a, space, and backspace still did not insert. The prescribed (250,900) click dismissed Spotlight.
hypotheses.hid_keyboard_report_not_delivered: rejected. Same A2 report path opened Control Center and dismissed Spotlight with Home. Letter writes returned code 0. C24C inserts the same report format.

root_cause: C241 has Full Keyboard Access on. Character keys are accessibility commands until Typing Mode is entered. The Spotlight insertion cursor is UIKit focus, not Typing Mode. Space while the blue ring was on AssistiveTouch opened that menu instead of inserting a space. C24C types directly and its Control Center did not show an FKA ring. Toggling FKA off then on left it on. AirPlay reconnect does not change that. The kernel was not restarted.

resolution.worked: From Home, click (250,900), wait 1.0s, Tab until the blue FKA ring is on the search-field control (6 Tabs in this run, starting on AssistiveTouch), Space, then /key/sendkey text. hi appeared.
resolution.exit_typing_mode: On-screen hint is Control+Tab. This kernel has no verified Control+Tab fn_key. Escape cleared the banner once.
resolution.direct_typing: Turn Full Keyboard Access off on C241 to match C24C. Do not toggle it back on and expect sendkey text to land.
resolution.not_changed: No kernel code change. PID 31944 left running.
